notes.content:

New Visuals:

notes.title: Demo Version 18 (28-4-2023)
notes.content:
[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Bane "Everlasting Drough" was applying value of 2 (less cards) instead of 1.
- Fixed Soft Lock when a portal was facing towards the edge of the world and no other portals were opened.
- Enemy Gargolye being invisible fixed.
- Building Selection was broken in some situations and stayed selected. 
- Card "Armory" was meant to be trashed on played, we set it as that.
- Card Unlocks were only unlocking the card for round 10. 
- Getting multiple Altar Offerings at the same time was broken. Now it properly waits until you choose an offering to popup the next one.
- Audio Settings Panel was trolling users by modifying the sliders automatically. Not intentionally of course :P

[b]Changes:[/b]

- Reworked Library, Gardens, Town. They are more place situational now.

[b]Tweaks:[/b]
- Cannon damage was nerfed.
- Flamethrower received a few changes.
- Radiance was tweaked.
- Enemies hp scales a higher starting round 30

[b]Others:[/b]
- Camera zoom improvements: it has more zoom out distance, and zoom speed adapts to how far the camera is from the floor.
- Minor fixes, wording/typo corrections, etc.

As always, huge shotout to our amazing community for the feedback, suggestions and more!

notes.title: Demo Version 17
notes.content:
[b]Note[/b]: 
Balance tweaks are temporary and for the Demo Only.
The Early Access build will have new gameplay features, more elements, etc.
We want you to have the most fun as possible with the Demo so we'll keep tweaking, but we don't expect it to be perfectly balanced. We also encourage you to try beating the game in different ways and share it in the community: it's not just about winning but HOW you win! 

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- fixed "max enemies reached" error that broke game.
- fixed Invisible unit (Siege)

[b]Tweaks:[/b]

- Overall towers tweak. They're cheaper to play and a bit less powerful. 
- Radiance now is "Ground" only and has cd delay for units affected.
- Mage now applies 3% hex and the effect stacks up to 15%. If the hex finishes, the stack is emptied.
- We changed how Altars make their offerings. Now they offer a Bane and a Boon, and you can accept or reject it.
- Tweaks on different setting curves (gold drop, hp, etc)
- Tweaks on some cards.

Others:
- We changed how cards are unlocked. You can now unlock up to 3 cards per run (by reaching levels 10, 20 and 30).
- Selected Tower Info Panel now shows "average damage per second". This is just a rough estimate of how much damage the tower makes in a second assuming it always hit valid targets in constant ratio.

notes.title: Demo Version 16
notes.content:
Fixes
- Wrong text on Tower Types was corrected. AIR and GROUND were swapped causing big confusion and drop of market stocks. 
- Fixed Siege model being huge (again, this one for real?)
- Tab Info Panel "Enemies" was not working and breaking the game.
- Dark Max Targets Text was not showing correctly.
- Library was not drawing cards properly
- Some other small fixes
- Flamethrower was not applyng damage properly. 

Tweaks:
- Multiple Balance changes
- Sectors now have more variety of height in tiles.
- Tectonic Sorcery was buffed.
- Everlasting Drough reduces your draw by 1 card now instead of 2.
- Federal Zone now gives 50% fire rate instead of 100%.

notes.title: Demo Version 11 is Live
notes.content:
Features:

- Damage Type and Resistance Added. Tower have Physical, Magica and True damage types
- Resistances have colors (Armor: yellow, Magic Resistance: blue, Both: red)
- Now you can select enemies in the map and also in the "Enemies" tab to see their information.
- Cards now have rarity, which affects the chances of getting those cards during a run.
- Beating a boss now gives you a reward of Epic cards choice. 
- 3 new cards added to the base set: The Tri-Wander-Force. 

Fixes: 

- Ice Pillar effect was not being applied properly
- Tooltips were fixed here and there. Also they have new visual style.
- Dark Tower now shows the right amount of "max targets" when selected.
- Fixed Dark Tower perma stun issue.
- Buidings that affect other buildings in range now display the affected tiles and buildings (ie: Mine, Barracks..)
- Enemies had all the same speed and that was not intended. We fixed it.

Others:
- Multiple minor fixes and tweaks
- Light Beacon Sectors now are generated if you build a sector 2 blocks away, so they don't seem like they come out of nowhere blocking your paths.
- Fixed soft lock with card sectors that was happening randomly. It may still happen in some situations, please let us know if it does!
- vfx on enemy dies is more apparent now
- Now Fire Plume can't get Fire Plumes as result of its ability.
